title.narrative: Secure cross border social economic and commercial activities in the Great Lakes region

description.narrative: The creation of a One-Stop Border Post aims to (1) reduce the burden caused by any traditional border crossing, (2) increase the flow of trade between the two countries, (3) reduce the occurrence of Gender Based Violence and of other harassment cases, and (4) reinforce the social relationships between border communities in the fragile environment of the sub region of the Great Lakes
